text:
Silver Price in 2011
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2011, the LBMA silver price rose 1.5% between 2011-01-31 ($27.75) and 2011-12-30 ($28.18). The highest sampled price was $48.70 in April and the lowest was $27.75 in January. The mean of these observations was $35.56. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2011:
Gold set what was then an all-time high near $1,900 amid the European debt crisis and the first-ever downgrade of the US credit rating.
